name: interview-prep-chat
description: Interview questions to ask, STAR story outlines, and offer clarification prep from JD and resume. Emits interview-prep-report. Not legal advice.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include JD, resume, interview stage, or company name.

inputs.name: job-description
inputs.description: Job posting to tailor questions and STAR themes.

inputs.name: resume-text
inputs.description: Optional resume paste or summary for STAR mapping.

inputs.name: interview-stage
inputs.description: Stage such as screening, onsite, technical, or offer.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Answers from a prior clarification loop.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: interview-prep-report
outputs.description: Structured interview prep; empty when role context is too thin.
